name: Ülker Laviva Filled Chocolate with Biscuits 35 g
truth: Sugar, vegetable fat (palm), whole milk powder, wheat flour, cocoa mass, cocoa butter, fat reduced cocoa powder (5%), hazelnut puree, emulsifiers (soy lecithin, polyglycerol polyricinoleate), corn starch, invert sugar syrup, skimmed milk powder, salt, flavourings, raising agents (sodium hydrogen carbonate, disodium diphosphate), whey powder (milk), butter oil (milk). May contain traces of other nuts, egg products and peanuts.
